**Family**
e.g. `814.0 RegioNova`

**Livery**
Operator and short name, e.g. "ČD — PID šedo-červená".

**References**
Photos, Wikipedia links, operator press kit, etc. — anything that documents the
real-world paint scheme. The more reference angles, the better.

**Notes**
Anything unusual: doors painted a different color, asymmetric ends, retired in a
specific year, ran only on a specific line, …
